title: Nonparentage as defense.
bodyText: A party whose parentage of a child has been previously determined by or pursuant to law may not plead nonparentage as a defense to a proceeding under this chapter.
bodyHtml: §576B-315  Nonparentage as defense.  A party whose parentage of a child has been previously determined by or pursuant to law may not plead nonparentage as a defense to a proceeding under this chapter. [L 1997, c 295, pt of §1; am L 2015, c 77, pt of §1]
